title: 12-Day Turkey & Greek Islands: Aegean Treasures
metaDescription: Explore Istanbul and Cappadocia before continuing to Santorini, Mykonos and Athens on a 12-day journey connecting Turkey with the Cyclades.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 12-Day Turkey & Greece Tour – Aegean Treasures creates an overland and island journey from Istanbul to Santorini, with major cultural stops on both sides of the Aegean. Explore Istanbul before flying to Cappadocia, then continue west to ancient Ephesus. The Greek portion begins in Athens and shifts to the Cyclades, with separate stays in Mykonos and Santorini rather than brief cruise calls, allowing the itinerary to balance guided sightseeing with independent island time.
Travel dates and pacing can be adjusted around available connections. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees during guided visits, domestic flights, Greek ferries, airport transfers and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise and then Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements Following the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Santorini to relax on the beaches or explore the charming town of Fira.
Optional boat or bus excursions to the volcano and nearby islands are available. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Mykonos By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Santorini for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Mykonos and Mykonos Town, famous for its beautiful beaches, charming streets, boutique shops, cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out.
Transfer to the port in Mykonos for your ferry to Athens. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel.
Free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a half-day city tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Return to the hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 12-Day Turkey and Greece Tour – Aegean Treasures?
faqs.a: The 12-Day Turkey and Greece Tour – Aegean Treasures covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Santorini, Mykonos, and Athens. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's unique landscapes and fairy chimneys, and then continue to Greece to experience the world-famous islands of Santorini and Mykonos before ending your journey in the historic city of Athens. The tour runs for 11 nights and 12 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 12-Day Turkey and Greece Tour – Aegean Treasures cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,895 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, ferry tickets between the Greek islands, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 12-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, and ferry transportation between Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini. These travel arrangements help maximize your vacation time while providing a smooth and comfortable travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 11 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions, city centers, and ferry ports. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 12-day Turkey and Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout Turkey and Greece.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is perfect for first-time visitors who want to experience both cultural landmarks and famous island destinations. It combines the history and architecture of Istanbul and Athens with the unique landscapes of Cappadocia and the beauty of Santorini and Mykonos.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 12-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, archaeological sites, island villages, and areas with uneven surfaces, including Cappadocia and the Acropolis. Most travelers in average health can comfortably enjoy the itinerary

faqs.q: Are Mykonos and Santorini included in the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, both Mykonos and Santorini are included in the itinerary. You will have free time to explore Mykonos' charming streets and lively atmosphere, as well as Santorini's famous caldera views, whitewashed villages, and breathtaking sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Aegean Treasures Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and peace of mind.

faqs.q: Is the 12-Day Turkey and Greece Tour – Aegean Treasures available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules, and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Istanbul, Athens, Mykonos, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
